content.short: SpaceBudz is a pioneering NFT platform on Cardano featuring a collection of 10,000 unique astronaut characters.
content.description: SpaceBudz is one of the foundational NFT projects in the Cardano ecosystem, featuring a limited collection of 10,000 unique astronaut characters. Each character is a distinct digital asset secured by the Cardano multi-asset ledger. Created by the developer behind Nami Wallet, SpaceBudz set the standard for metadata and ownership within the community. The platform offers a user-friendly marketplace where collectors can trade and showcase their astronauts, fostering a vibrant and dedicated community of early blockchain art enthusiasts and long-term supporters of the ecosystem.
content.meta: SpaceBudz is a pioneering Cardano NFT platform with 10,000 unique astronaut characters and classic CNFT history. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
